Linux cache transactions now recover only staging directories with proven ownership after an interrupted process. Unknown/legacy temporary data and completed references are preserved. ONNX model data is separated from ownership metadata, including external weights with matching filenames.

TensorRT reserves staging after acquiring its key lock. Its Linux builder stops when its parent dies; killed children cannot publish a partial plan. Short partial-write/interruption checks passed for flow exports, snapshots, TensorRT and native motion export, with exact recovered bytes/output on the tested inputs. No FPS gain is claimed.

See [the qualification report](https://github.com/Ta2b/mpv-AnimeJaNai-HDR/blob/release/docs/qualification/lot-11-cache-recovery-20261016.md). Other native platforms and disk/quota handling remain separate qualification work. Platform assets appear as their independent builds complete.
